_readme: Empty by design. Every pre-existing schema-only numeric claim was resolved on 2026-08-26 by applying the rule: if the number is not visible on the page, it leaves the schema. Any entry added here needs a written justification — the default is to fix the schema, not to exempt it.

thirdPartyOffers.why: Quarantined 2026-09-19 when check 3 landed. The Offer carries apps.json's $145–$275 (verified 2026-08-08, analyzify.com/pricing), but this page prices Analyzify per year (~$749/yr, ~$62–$79/mo) and itself notes the billing basis is unresolved. Which figure is right is a content decision logged in CLAUDE.md under apps.json data problems; until it is made, the Offer does not match the page. Clear it by fixing the apps.json record or the page copy, not by editing this entry.
